correctness.summary: For every 0<c<=1/8, the quartic-profile maps are strict means with uniformly positive coordinate derivatives, while the second derivative of x->M_c^±(x,1) changes sign at x=2+sqrt(3), so each is neither convex nor concave.

limitations: No classification is proved for extra hypotheses that would restore an order-curvature implication.
Equivalent prior coverage under different mean parametrizations may have escaped the search.
Independent audit has not been performed.

originality.scope: to the best of our knowledge
originality.summary: The 2016 source explicitly poses Problem 4(ii). Searches by the exact statement, source identifiers, strict-monotone mean terminology, curvature terminology, and quartic-profile equivalents did not locate these counterexamples or a stronger result implying them; differently parametrized or weakly indexed prior coverage remains a residual risk.

review_statement: Same-model review: passed. Independent audit: not yet performed.

value.summary: The construction answers both halves of a published open problem negatively with one-parameter families of smooth strict-monotone counterexamples and isolates the mechanism separating order relative to A from curvature.
